objective: Run the frozen fully label-free v0.72 compiler, selector and exact lower-bound planners on seven deterministically selected, raw-byte-locked OpenML-CC18 ARFF datasets with independent Rust replay.

adapter_protocol.comments: lines whose first non-whitespace character is % are ignored
adapter_protocol.attributes: parse ordered @attribute declarations and preserve every non-target attribute in original order
adapter_protocol.target_column: the exact committed default_target_attribute; exactly one declaration must match
adapter_protocol.data: parse comma-separated dense rows with single- and double-quoted field support; reject sparse rows
adapter_protocol.values: strip exterior whitespace; preserve ? as an explicit feature token; labels must be nonempty
adapter_protocol.shape: row and declared attribute counts must exactly match the v0.77 lock

claim_boundary: A pass is a preregistered cross-source OpenML replication of the frozen exact method. It is not outside-human reproduction, direct state-of-the-art superiority, peer review, publication acceptance, a general-AI breakthrough, or a world-level/world-first claim. Every failed threshold remains a preserved rejection.
